# jobrunner

Small job runner with a configurable, bounded exponential retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` always makes the first call. `RetryConfig::max_attempts` is the
 total number of calls allowed, including that first call. Only
`RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; `Permanent` failures are
returned immediately.

Set `base_delay_ms` for the first retry and `max_delay_ms` for the upper bound.
Each later retry doubles the delay until it reaches the cap. Delays are passed
to the injected `Sleeper`, so callers can provide real sleeping or a test
sleeper such as `FakeSleeper`.
